## The Core Claim

The observed blackbody radiation spectrum cannot be derived from classical physics' assumption that energy exchange is continuous -- classical theory predicts an ultraviolet catastrophe that is not observed. Assuming instead that energy is exchanged only in discrete quanta (E = hf) exactly reproduces the real observed spectrum. Planck won the 1918 Nobel Prize in Physics for this, the founding result of quantum theory.
